remarks: Beautifully updated and expanded, this stunning 5BR/5.2BA home is nestled on 4.5 level acres just minutes from town, the train, and top-rated schools. Originally built in 1968, the home was completely gutted to the studs and fully renovated in 2004/2005 with a new architect, featuring all-new kitchen, baths, and thoughtfully designed additions. Exceptional details abound, including sun-drenched living spaces, a custom kitchen with a center island and cathedral ceilings, a dual staircase, and hardwood floors throughout. A separate bonus room with an office and full bath offers an ideal Au Pair or In-Law suite. The walk-out lower-level playroom adds extra versatility. Outdoors, a charming slate terrace and heated pool create the perfect setting for entertaining. Situated on a quiet cul-de-sac, this home offers both privacy and convenience.
